description.en: Specifies whether to enable simple mode.
The ID of the escalation policy.

description.zh:
设置事件分组。
	

- 不填（默认）：所有告警会按`alertname`分组发送给处理人。
- 设置分组字段：相同字段的告警内容会分别通过独立信息发送给处理人。
分组格式如下：

```
{ 
"groupWait":5,    //分组等待时间。
"groupInterval":30,     //分组间隔时间。
"groupingFields":["alertname"]       //分组字段。
}
```
description.en:
An array of alert event group objects.

*   If you do not specify the groupingFields field, all alerts will be sent to contacts based on `alertname`.
*   If you specify the groupingFields field, alerts with the same field will be sent to contacts in one notification.

Sample statement:

    { 
    "groupWait":5,    // The waiting time for grouping. 
    "groupInterval":30,     // The time interval of grouping. 
    "groupingFields":["alertname"]       // The field that is used to group alert events. 
    }

description.zh:
通知策略ID。

- 不填代表创建新的通知策略。
- 填写代表修改指定通知策略信息。
description.en:
The ID of the notification policy.

*   If you do not specify this parameter, a new notification policy is created.
*   If you specify this parameter, the specified notification policy is modified.

description.zh: 告警需要推送到的工单系统，填写工单系统的集成ID。
description.en: The integration ID of the ticket system to which alerts are pushed.
The name of the notification policy.

description.zh:
设置通知规则。格式如下：
```
{ 
 "notifyStartTime":"00:00",      //通知时间段开始时间。
 "notifyEndTime":"23:59",       //通知时间段结束时间。
 "notifyChannels":["dingTalk", "email", "sms", "tts", "webhook"],       //通知方式，包括dingTalk(钉钉）、email（邮件）、sms（短信）、tts（电话）和webhook。
 "notifyObjects":[{       //通知对象。
 "notifyObjectType":"CONTACT",       //通知对象类型，包括CONTACT（联系人）、CONTACT_GROUP（联系人组）、ARMS_CONTACT（ARMS联系人）、ARMS_CONTACT_GROUP（ARMS联系人组）、DING_ROBOT_GROUP（钉钉/飞书/企业微信 IM机器人）、CONTACT_SCHEDULE（排班表）。
 "notifyObjectId":123,       //通知对象ID。
 "notifyObjectName":"test"       //通知对象名称。
 "notifyChannels": [			//通知对象为联系人时单独指定的联系方式。包括email（邮件）、sms（短信）、tts（电话）
                "email",		
                "sms",
                "tts"
            ],
 }]
```
description.en:
An array of notification rule objects. Format:

    { 
     "notifyStartTime":"00:00",      // The start time of the notification window. 
     "notifyEndTime":"23:59",       // The end time of the notification window. 
     "notifyChannels":["dingTalk", "email", "sms", "tts", "webhook"],       // The notification methods. Valid values: dingTalk, email, sms, tts, and webhook. 
     "notifyObjects":[{       // An array of notification objects. 
     "notifyObjectType":"CONTACT",       // The type of the notification object. Valid values: CONTACT (contact), CONTACT_GROUP (contact group), ARMS_CONTACT (ARMS contact), ARMS_CONTACT_GROUP (ARMS contact group), DING_ROBOT_GROUP (DingTalk, Lark, WeCom, or IM robot), and CONTACT_SCHEDULE (user on duty defined by a schedule). 
     "notifyObjectId":123,       // The ID of the notification object. 
     "notifyObjectName":"test"       // The name of the notification object. 
     }]

description.zh: 通知模板。示例模板请参见表格下方说明。
description.en: The notification template. The default notification template is provided below the table.

description.zh:
对于长期未解决的告警是否发送重复通知。

- `true`（默认）：设置为`true`后，必须设置**RepeatInterval**。
- `false`：设置为`false`后，必须设置**EscalationPolicyId**。
description.en:
Specifies whether to resend a notification for a long-lasting unresolved alert. Default value: true. Valid values:

*   `true`: If you set this parameter to `true`, you must set **RepeatInterval**.
*   `false`: If you set this parameter to `false`, you must set **EscalationPolicyId**.

description.zh: 重复通知时间间隔，单位为秒。
description.en: The time interval at which a notification is resent for a long-lasting unresolved alert. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
当告警下面全部事件都恢复时，告警状态是否自动恢复为已解决。当告警恢复时，系统将会发送通知给处理人。

- `true`（默认）：发送通知。
- `false`：不发送通知。
description.en:
Specifies whether the status of an alert automatically changes to Resolved when all events related to the alert change to the Restored state. ARMS notifies contacts when the alert status changes to Resolved.

*   `true`: The system sends a notification.
*   `false`: The system does not send a notification.

description.zh: 通知策略是否启用，enable 启用，disable 停用
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the notification policy. Valid values: enable and disable.
